## My process

### Built with

- Mobile-first workflow

### What I learned

During this challenge I was able to reinforce some knowledge about:

**CSS layout**

It's interesting to know that when the screen width or height are too short, you could use **padding** in the body, toghether with **max-width** and **width: 100%**, without even using media queries. 

Like here: 

```css
.card-wrapper {
    max-width: 384px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    width: 100%;
}
```

### Continued development

Responsiveness feels very important to make your components flexible regardless of the screen resolution that you use.

### Useful resources

-  [Focus visible doc](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/Reference/Selectors/:focus-visible) - This helped me to understand more about focus-visible attribute, used mostly for those who don't have a mouse and use Tab to access the clickable components.

I'm at a stage where every thing is a mean to learn so I've been using AI to ask questions to evaluate current solutions and that feels so good to be able to understand things so easily and be able to apply them as well.
